description: A configurable 2D game character sprite: original teen female superhero with a slim athletic build. Long flowing soft pink/magenta hair past her shoulders, light skin. Wears a tight pink bodysuit with a white central section. Pink domino mask across the eyes only, hair visible above and around it. Pink gloves and pink boots. A circular atomic orbit emblem on the chest. Controlled floaty hover pose, hands slightly raised, effortlessly composed expression.

animations.name: idle-lineup
animations.action: hovering slightly off the ground in a lineup for a family photo, floating gently up and down, hands relaxed at sides or slightly out, looking at camera with effortless cool confidence
